d: The women's 3km Knockout Sprint delivers fast-paced open water action as athletes compete across successive elimination rounds. With limited opportunities to advance, every race is crucial in this exciting format that combines endurance, speed, and tactical awareness on the road to the podium.

Watch the 2026 World Athletics Road Running Championships live on Eurovision Sport. The world's best distance runners tackle the streets of Copenhagen in the Half Marathon, as the championships crown their final world champions.

Speed, strategy, and survival take centre stage in the men's 3km Knockout Sprint. Swimmers progress through multiple elimination rounds, with every stage demanding maximum effort as athletes race to secure their place in the final and challenge for victory in Cancun.
